title: Co-design the Crow-inspired MCH clock and ADC TDM pin-field escapes

origin.revision: synthetic reduction from verified 2026-09-16 and 2026-09-20 evidence
origin.reduction: Synthetic three-terminal MCH_CLK/ADC_TDM F.Cu coupon. It preserves the documented classes: isolated legal routes that collide when composed, an inherited early branch occupying a later terminal's launch, and frozen width/layer/zero-via/net-population constraints. It is not the historical Crow board, route chain, pad density, or proof of general routability or impossibility. Provenance revisions are 0dd098e2b58dc8750b19ab9305a78e46a9c92c5b and 99557b65a4b74892b1ac61e5a3753463bab9d133.

history.disposition: Per-net isolation passed, but the accepted early MCH_CLK branch crosses ADC_TDM and blocks its required pin-field launch in the combined native witness.
history.reconsider_when: Current source geometry regenerates a combined native witness that connects all six terminals and passes the production coupled-neighborhood gate with frozen F.Cu, width, and zero-via constraints.

history.disposition: Route-order reversal reproduced the same combined collision because it did not change the physical cut.
history.reconsider_when: Placement, legal layers, effective rules, or an independently graded crossover changes the cut; invalidate and replay both affected nets.

history.disposition: Grid and search retries preserved the obstructing early branch and therefore did not create terminal-launch capacity.
